comments.name: GlobalCitizen
comments.content: Seriously? The US-Iran conflict again? Oil prices up 5%, stock market bloodbath, and even gold is down. This geopolitical instability is really affecting global markets, not just here but across Asia and Europe. The bond market situation, with US and Japan yields hitting new highs, indicates a deeper systemic issue. Citadel's advice for a 'tactical downside window' in Sept for US stocks makes sense. It's time to be cautious and maybe look into hedging strategies. The new tax policy on foreign dividends is also something international investors need to watch closely. The AI race, though, is fascinating – Astra achieving human-level computer operation is a game-changer. It's a double-edged sword: immense potential but also significant disruption. We're living in truly uncertain but exciting times. Keep an eye on those emerging tech sectors, but always remember to diversify your portfolio. 🌍

comments.name: 王工说事
